tag: tess-hunt FFI search, sector 6 detection, multi-sector confirmed
notes: Detected in an independent BLS search of SPOC FFI cutouts (astrocut, S3 cubes) of Tmag 12-15 M dwarfs. Signal recovered independently in every available sector. Centroid and noise-normalized difference images place the dip on the target in all tested 200-s sectors. Odd/even depths agree within 2.1 sigma; no secondary eclipse. batman+emcee fit with free quadratic limb darkening. Transit-derived stellar density 0.2 solar vs TIC 3.4 solar. Not a TOI; no literature match; not in the ExoFOP CTOI list (4936 entries, 2026-10-26).
